The '''''Altor''-class replenishment ship''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] support ship class that carried fuel for other vessels in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==Description==
[[File:Naval_Station_Validusia.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Three ''Altor''s among several other large capital ships being serviced at [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']]. Sternward drydock modules are visible on the ship to the upper right.]]

===Dimensions===
The ''Altor''-class was a large Imperial supply ship model and carried six pill-shaped fuel containers. In addition, it also contained at least four arm nozzles to refuel capital ships. The ''Altor'' was capable of refuelling two [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]]- and [[dreadnought]]-scale ships at the same time, one on each side.<ref name="EGW" />

At the stern of the vessel were located several hangar/drydock complexes that could fit [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]-scale capital ships for deep space repairs.<ref name="EGW" />

===Propulsion systems===
The ship was moved by a cluster of seven large thrusters, each circled by a cluster of eight auxiliary thrusters.<ref name="EGW" />

==History==
The class consisted of at least three ships. The vessels were capable of refueling various Imperial warships, including [[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|''Allegiance''-class battlecruisers]] and [[Assertor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Assertor''-class dreadnoughts]]. An ''Altor''-class vessel partook in a fleet exercise at some point after the [[Arms Race]] campaign,<ref name="Arms Race timeframe">Three [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s were seen flying in formation during the refilling procedure, which indicates that it took place after the [[Arms Race]] campaign shown in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], due to the TIE/ad starfighter entering the Imperial Navy after the events of that campaign.</ref> where it simultaneously refueled a Star Dreadnought and a battlecruiser of this kind. ''Altor''s were known to be serviced at [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']] in the [[Validusia system/Legends|Validusia system]].<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:AltorClassReplenishmentShip-FractalSponge.jpg|thumb|Ansel Hsiao's model.]]
This design originated as a [[fanon]] vessel made by [[Ansel Hsiao]]. His original intention was to create a ship that was capable of replenishing a single ship comparable in size to an ''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought, or an entire squadron of smaller ships.<ref name="projects">{{WebCite|url=http://fractalsponge.net/3D%20Projects.htm|text=3D Projects: Past, Present, and Future|archivedate=20200116164039}}</ref> When approached by [[Lucas Licensing]] to provide artwork for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', Hsiao submitted his own designs in addition to new models, along with their names. The names were recorded in LFL's [[Holocron continuity database]], according to the artist.<ref name="Fractalsponge comments">{{WebCite|url=https://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&sid=e8501d9d9e2ccc9a1c18226a2628097f&start=1575|text=Something big - Page 64|work=stardestroyer.net|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/Xcz6}}</ref>
